remarks: Rare opportunity to own one of the sprawling combined residences at the prestigious Park Tower. This wonderful unit features a complete top-to-bottom renovation, highlighted by a brand-new gourmet kitchen with a center island and exquisitely renovated bathrooms, including a primary spa-bath with a soaking tub and separate shower. The flexible layout offers 3 bedrooms plus a dedicated office, a private sitting room, and a massive walk-in closet, all complemented by breathtaking views from two private balconies. Residents enjoy world-class building amenities including 24-hour security, full concierge service, a year-round indoor pool, and a stunning rooftop deck with panoramic skyline views. For ultimate commuting ease, the building provides a private weekday shuttle service directly to the Stamford train station. Perfectly situated just steps from Stamford's premier dining, shopping, and Metro-North, this home offers the absolute peak of luxury and convenience.
